study_design: Ecological multicenter study comparing population-level adipose-tissue fatty-acid composition across 11 centers with published regional cancer-incidence figures.
reason: The study evaluates ecological associations with prostate cancer incidence but reports no aggressive prostate cancer endpoint and does not follow an initially cancer-free individual-level cohort.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: N-6 fatty acids were not associated significantly with breast, colon or prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The prostate endpoint is cancer incidence overall at the ecological population level; no aggressive subtype is reported.
